name: github-ssh-switcher
title: GitHub SSH Switcher
description: Switch between GitHub SSH accounts by loading the right key into ssh-agent
author: ricardoch

commands.name: switch-account
commands.title: Switch GitHub SSH Account
commands.subtitle: SSH Switcher
commands.description: Clear current SSH keys and load the selected GitHub account key

preferences.name: account1Title
preferences.title: Account 1 — Name
preferences.description: Display name shown in the Raycast list

preferences.name: account1Subtitle
preferences.title: Account 1 — Email / Username
preferences.description: Shown as subtitle below the account name

preferences.name: account1KeyPath
preferences.title: Account 1 — SSH Key Path
preferences.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the private key file

preferences.name: account1Host
preferences.title: Account 1 — SSH Host Alias
preferences.description: Host alias from ~/.ssh/config that maps to github.com
